title: Apollo Research papers feed
description: Unofficial feed of Apollo Research's All research listing, including the research agenda. Separate system-card panels and the general blog are excluded. Titles, dates and links belong to Apollo Research.

title: Swarma articles and papers feed
description: Unofficial feed of articles and curated Complexity and AI+Science papers from Swarma Pattern (集智斑图). Paper refreshes cover a rolling 90-day publication window; previously collected entries are retained. Links lead to original Pattern pages.

title: Michael Levin papers feed
description: Unofficial feed of the main bibliography on the Levin Lab Peer-Reviewed Papers page, including its listed papers, chapters and books. Conference abstracts and posters are excluded. RSS dates use January 1 of each publication year as sorting placeholders; exact publication dates are unknown.
